title: Enhance UI design and visual polish

requirements.text: Redesign the overall UI with improved visual hierarchy, spacing, and typography to create a more polished and modern appearance while maintaining the professional corporate style
acceptanceCriteria: Improved spacing and padding throughout the application for better visual breathing room
Enhanced typography hierarchy with clear differentiation between headings, body text, and labels
Consistent visual design language applied across all pages and components
Professional and polished appearance that elevates the current design

requirements.text: Enhance the report request form (ReportRequestForm.tsx) with improved visual design including better field layouts, refined input styling, and clearer visual feedback for validation states
acceptanceCriteria: Form fields have improved visual styling with clear focus states
Better visual distinction between required and optional fields
Enhanced error message presentation with improved color and placement
Success alerts are more visually prominent and well-designed

requirements.text: Improve the dashboard table design (RequestsDashboard.tsx) with enhanced visual styling including better row hover states, improved status badges, and clearer column headers
acceptanceCriteria: Table has improved visual styling with better borders and spacing
Row hover states are more prominent and polished
Status badges have enhanced visual design with better color coding
Column headers are visually distinct and easier to scan

requirements.text: Enhance the navigation and header design (Layout.tsx) with improved tab styling, better role toggle presentation, and more polished overall layout
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation tabs have improved visual design with clearer active states
Header layout is more polished with better spacing and alignment
Role toggle component has enhanced visual presentation
Overall header feels more premium and professional

requirements.text: Refine the modal design (RequestDetailModal.tsx) with improved visual styling, better content organization, and enhanced interactive elements for the review workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Modal has improved visual design with better shadows and borders
Content sections within the modal are better organized with clear visual separation
Review controls have enhanced styling with clearer call-to-action buttons
Modal overlay and transitions feel more polished

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive visual theme across the application with a sophisticated color palette, refined use of shadows and elevation, and consistent interactive element styling to create a premium user experience
acceptanceCriteria: A refined color palette is consistently applied throughout the application
Shadows and elevation are used strategically to create visual depth
All buttons, inputs, and interactive elements share consistent styling patterns
The overall visual theme feels cohesive and premium across all pages

constraints: Maintain the existing functional behavior of all components
Do not modify the backend logic or data structures
Preserve the current role-based access control and navigation structure
Keep the professional corporate style direction
Do not change paths in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Adding new features or functionality beyond visual improvements
Changing the information architecture or navigation structure
Modifying backend API endpoints or data models
Adding animations beyond subtle transitions for polish
